title: Software Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer Work Arrangement: Candidates will be required to work onsite during the first 1-2 weeks of onboarding. After this period, the position will be remote, with availability to work from the Mexico City office whenever needed. About the Company Our client is a global provider of AI-powered legal technology, eDiscovery, digital forensics, information governance, and data recovery solutions. The organization helps law firms, corporations, and government agencies navigate complex litigation, compliance, investigation, and data management challenges through innovative technology and specialized professional services. About the Role As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining mission-critical eDiscovery software used by legal teams around the world. This is a hands-on engineering position where you will own features from concept to production, leveraging modern AI development tools while maintaining high standards of quality, reliability, and accountability. The ideal candidate is passionate about building scalable software solutions, has strong experience with .NET/C# and PostgreSQL, and enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. What you'll do Day to day, you will design and implement features in .NET/C# services backed by PostgreSQL and writing automated tests. You will investigate and resolve production issues while tracing problems through the stack. You will use AI tooling daily for code generation, review, test, and debugging, and you will verify its output before it ships. You will also mentor junior engineers, including on responsible and effective use of AI in software development, and contribute to the design discussions and code reviews that keep the codebase healthy. Skills and experience: 5+ years of professional software development experience in .NET/C# Solid PostgreSQL experience, including schema design and query performance a Experience building and supporting scalable systems A habit of automated testing. Experience owning production systems from debugging, resolving, and learning from live incidents Daily fluency with AI development tooling, paired with the judgment to verify and take responsibility for what it produces Strong written and spoken communication, suited to distributed teams working across time zones Mission and core values Our mission is to bring clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide. Four values shape how we work. Client is Always in the Room. We operate and make decisions as if the client is in the room. We anticipate their needs, consider their perspective, and prioritize their best interests. Better Every Day. We improve our tomorrow by always striving to be better than today. We embrace curiosity, question assumptions, and raise the bar constantly. Own the Outcome. We bring an unwavering bias for action, act with urgency, and hold ourselves accountable to our clients and each other. Deliver Results Together. We collaborate obsessively to achieve shared success. We assume good intentions, debate ideas thoughtfully, treat each other with respect, and fully commit once decisions are made. Our culture shapes our actions, our products, and the relationships we forge with our customers.

title: Account Executive
description:
Mercell is the leading SaaS platform for public procurement in Europe.
At Mercell , we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.
With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.
Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.
Your Mission
We are looking for an ambitious Account Executive to join our Buy side sales team in Germany.
Our Account Executives are at the heart of Mercell ’s mission. You’ll be a trusted advisor to public sector customers with a go-to-market approach guiding them through a value based buying journey and showing how Mercell ’s solutions can help them achieve efficiency, compliance, and real impact for society. You’ll manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and qualifying leads (both inbound and outbound) to running demos, managing tender responses, negotiating terms, and closing deals. With each success, you’ll help strengthen Mercell ’s presence in your market and expand our growing community of public sector partners.
Core Responsibilities

• Proactively identify, engage, and build relationships with key decision-makers across your market.

• Translate the business pains of the organization into a value based selling approach to drive large strategic engagements.

• Own the entire sales journey from first contact and discovery to negotiation, closing, onboarding, and upselling.

• Confidently demonstrate the value and impact of Mercell ’s SaaS platform to organisations of all sizes.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM data in HubSpot, using insights to optimise pipeline and sales performance.

• Stay ahead of developments in the local and European public procurement landscape to uncover new growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications

• Strong experience (ideally 3-5 years) managing a full B2B SaaS sales cycle, preferably to the public sector or highly regulated industries with a tender driven sales motion.

• Strong experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation with demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

• Ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and decision-makers, building trust and credibility.

• Explaining the value of technical or SaaS solutions to a wide range of audiences.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

• Fluency in written and spoken German.

Preferred Qualifications

• Familiarity with public procurement, tendering, or compliance-driven buying processes.

• Experience working in an international or multi-market sales environment.

• Strong consultative selling mindset with a focus on long-term customer value.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, and collaborative environment where priorities evolve.

Start date: As soon as possible
Duration: Full time
Workplace type: Remote
Location: Berlin, Germany
Application Deadline: 11 October 2026. However, do not wait to submit your application - we will read applications and talk to potential candidates as we receive them

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. SpryPoint is modernizing how utilities serve their communities. As a high-growth software company, we're shaking up the status quo in the utility industry with the first and only truly cloud-native customer service and operations platform purpose-built for modern utilities.
Founded by industry veterans in 2011, we've grown from a profitable startup to a rapidly scaling company of 300+ employees serving 100+ utility clients across North America and the Caribbean. Our mission is simple: utility leaders should expect more from their technology providers.

title: Team Lead (m/w/d) Field Sales - Wien
description:
Möchtest du deine Sales-Fähigkeiten an andere weitergeben und für das Wachstum von Salonkee in [REGION] verantwortlich sein? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturiertes Management-Onboarding, ein eigenes Team, das du weiter ausbaust, sowie Verantwortung und Vertrauen.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE:

- Team aufbauen und entwickeln: Du startest entweder als erstes Teammitglied oder mit einem kleinen Team, das du weiter ausbaust.

- Du entwickelst dein Team durch Coaching, Shadowing und Roleplays - nicht nur durch Steuerung & Monitoring.

- Lead by Example: In der Aufbauphase gewinnst du auch selbst Neukund:innen, mit einem klar definierten eigenen Zielanteil. So kennst du den Markt aus erster Hand.

- Präsenz im Markt: Du begleitest dein Team zu Terminen, unterstützt in der Akquise und überzeugst live in Demos.

- Du steuerst datenbasiert - über KPIs und Pipeline. Du kennst die Zahlen deiner Teammitglieder und leitest daraus frühzeitig Maßnahmen ab.

- Struktur und Rhythmus: Du organisierst die Woche, führst 1:1-Gespräche, löst Hindernisse schnell und sorgst für saubere Arbeit im CRM.

- Du entwickelst deine Region strategisch weiter und wirkst an der Optimierung unserer Vertriebsprozesse mit.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb, davon nachweisbar im Außendienst (Field Sales) mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung.

- Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Neukundengewinnung: Du kannst mit Zahlen belegen, was du erreicht hast und woran du festmachst, dass du darin gut bist.

- Führungserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist, dass du die Fähigkeiten hast, deine Teammitglieder zu entwickeln und für Wachstum zu sorgen. Relevante Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Mentoring, Onboarding neuer Kolleg:innen oder in Projekten sind hilfreich.

- Datenaffinität: Du arbeitest sicher mit KPIs, Pipeline und Forecast und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du planst deine Region eigenständig und setzt klare Prioritäten.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Führungskräfte-Entwicklung von Tag 1: Unsere Sales Manager Academy begleitet dich beim Einstieg in die Führungsrolle - gerade dann, wenn es dein erstes Team ist.

- Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest mit, wen du einstellst und wie dein Team arbeitet.

- Ein Vergütungspaket, das Team- und Eigenleistung honoriert: attraktives Fixum plus ungedeckelte Provision.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Credit Controller
description:
A little bit about us…
We make life more affordable.
Pion produces award-winning technology for the biggest retailers on the planet, connecting them with the youth market. We’re always innovating and driving our SHARP values to offer new solutions that satisfy our consumers, drive ROI for our clients and create an empowering workplace for our employees.
Equity, Diversity & Inclusion at Pion

At Pion , inclusivity, diversity, and respect are at our core. We value accountability and are fully transparent about our ED&I efforts-our commitments and internal stats are open for all to see. Our culture is shaped by our people, and it’s all part of life at Pion .
Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet 60% of the requirements, women and those in underrepresented groups tend to only apply when they tick every box. We don’t think you should have to tick every box. We value your uniqueness, and it goes without saying that all applications are welcome, even if you don’t think you fit the criteria.
If you need any adjustments to support you with your application, just drop us an email at .
As a result of our incredible success and growth, we are looking for a Credit Controller to join us.
Responsibilities include

• Own a personal ledger within the team's shared cash collection target, proactively chasing invoices rather than just following process from very old, overdue accounts to invoices due for the first time.

• Contact customers and their payment partners to confirm invoices have been received and scheduled for payment, chasing consistently in the run-up to and past the due date.

• Keep Sage fully up to date so the team always has an accurate picture of progress across the ledger.

• Solve problems as they come up by reissuing invoices, tracking down supporting contracts, requesting POs, and running claims through payment portals.

• Build strong working relationships across finance, sales, and with customers and third-party payment processors to keep cash moving as efficiently as possible.

Requirements
A little bit about you.
We’d really like to hear from you, if you have

• Experience as a credit controller in a high-volume environment (think hundreds of invoices and customers on the go at once), motivated by hitting cash collection targets.

• A tenacious, resourceful approach to problem solving - you find a way to get things done, whatever the barriers, rather than giving up on a tricky account.

• Strong relationship-building skills across different stakeholders, from finance and sales through to customers and third parties.

• A logical, detail-focused mindset with the ability to prioritise and manage your own workload efficiently.

• Confidence working with systems to track and manage data (Sage Intacct experience, or exposure to affiliate networks in media/advertising, is a bonus).

Benefits
Benefits are in line with all standard benefits associated with individuals who have the right to work in the Philippines.
The benefits will be confirmed by an Employer of Record (EOR), and this role will be employed via that EOR.
Want to know more?
Check out our career site for everything you need to know about starting a career with Pion .
Due to the high volume of applicants, we can only respond to shortlisted applicants. By submitting your application, you agree that Pion may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organisation planning, and related purposes. Our Applicant Privacy Notice explains what personal information and where we may process, our purposes for processing, and the rights you can exercise over Pion ’s' use of your personal information.

title: Legal Engineer - Corporate
description:
Ready to step into a legal career at the forefront of AI and innovation?
Are you a lawyer or legal professional looking to move beyond traditional practice? Do you enjoy solving complex business challenges, advising senior stakeholders, and helping organisations embrace new technology?
We are looking for a Legal Engineer to partner with corporate legal departments, helping them modernise legal operations through AI-powered solutions, workflow transformation, and strategic advisory.
The Opportunity
This is a highly consultative role that blends legal expertise, technology, and client engagement.
You'll work closely with in-house legal teams to understand their operational priorities, identify opportunities for improvement, and demonstrate how our AI and legal technology solutions can transform the way they work.
If you're passionate about legal innovation, enjoy building trusted relationships, and want to influence the future of corporate legal departments, this is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact.
What You'll Be Doing

• Partner with corporate legal departments to understand their workflows, strategic priorities, and operational challenges.

• Advise clients on legal technology, AI adoption, legal operations, and workflow optimisation.

• Deliver tailored product demonstrations, executive briefings, workshops, and training sessions.

• Collaborate with Client Managers and Business Development teams to identify opportunities to expand existing customer relationships.

• Gather customer feedback on product enhancements, emerging AI use cases, and market trends, sharing insights with Product and Engineering teams.

• Become a trusted advisor to legal leaders navigating digital transformation.

What We're Looking For
You'll have a Juris Doctor (JD) and at least three years' experience in one or more of the following:

• In-house legal experience within a Fortune 1000 or similarly complex organisation.

• Legal operations, legal transformation, enterprise consulting, or legal technology implementation supporting corporate legal departments.

• An Alternative Legal Services Provider (ALSP), advising large enterprise clients on legal strategy and operations.

You'll also bring:

• A strong understanding of how corporate legal departments operate and the challenges they face.

• Practical experience using generative AI tools and an appreciation of how AI can improve legal workflows.

• Confidence discussing AI opportunities, governance, adoption, and risk with both legal and business stakeholders.

• Experience engaging with General Counsel, Chief Legal Officers, Legal Operations leaders, and other senior decision-makers.

• Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and consultative problem-solving skills.

• The ability to travel approximately 50% to support customers and business needs.

Preferred Experience
We're particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

• Legal operations or legal transformation initiatives.

• AI implementation and technology adoption.

• Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), workflow automation, legal knowledge management, or enterprise legal technology platforms.

• Enterprise-scale change management and digital transformation programmes.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

title: Vice President, AI Data
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

ABOUT US

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us-we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

The role

At Wayve, we are building AI that learns to drive from experience.

We do not hand-code cars to drive. We train our models from data gathered across the real world, making our ability to identify, understand and learn from the right data fundamental to everything we build.

We are looking for a VP of Data to lead the data strategy behind our autonomous driving technology.

This is a senior engineering leadership role with end-to-end ownership of how Wayve uses data to improve our AI. You will determine what data we need, how we acquire it, how we understand and enrich it, and ultimately how we turn it into measurable improvements in model performance.

The scale and shape of the problem is unique. Our data comes from our own vehicles, OEM programmes, partners and external sources, spanning different vehicles, sensors, markets and driving environments. Within that corpus, the most valuable examples are often the hardest to find: rare behaviours, unusual interactions, safety-critical events and the long tail of real-world driving.

Your job is not simply to build the systems that process this data. It is to decide what data matters and why, and build the strategy, organisation and learning loop that allows Wayve to learn from it faster.

You will lead Wayve’s Data organisation and provide senior ownership for data within Engineering, partnering closely across AI, Science, Validation, Product, Compute and our commercial teams.

Key Responsibilities

- Own Wayve’s data strategy: Set the strategy across the complete AI learning cycle, determining what data we need and how it should drive model performance, from foundation model training through specialised driving capabilities and production programmes.

- Build the data flywheel: Own the learning loop from real-world signals and model behaviour through data discovery, curation and enrichment into training, evaluation, deployment and measurement.

- Find the data that matters: Develop intelligent approaches to discovering rare, surprising and safety-critical scenarios within extremely large datasets, using techniques such as embeddings, semantic search, learned representations and model-driven data selection.

- Lead data acquisition and enrichment: Define how Wayve collects, buys, generates and enriches data across our own fleet, OEM programmes, partners and external sources, balancing coverage, quality, speed and economics.

- Connect data investment to model performance: Establish how we measure the value of data and make rigorous trade-offs across quality, accuracy, speed, cost and scale, ensuring investment is focused where it creates the greatest impact.

- Scale our data strategy globally: Build an approach that supports multiple OEMs, vehicle platforms, sensor configurations, geographies and regulatory environments while maintaining a scalable global architecture.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
This is a Toronto based hybrid 2x/week in office position.

About OpenTable:

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most - their team, their guests, and their bottom line - while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team that includes and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.

The Role:

The Senior Business Systems Analyst will join the Enterprise Systems Team within the Technology Operations organization and help build and deliver projects to increase business efficiency and automate global teams’ business processes. This individual will partner with finance, business, analytics, product, and engineering and manage several financial applications, configuring and building system enhancements, troubleshooting issues, and providing operational support to finance partners.

This is a Toronto based hybrid 2x/week in office position.

This position has responsibilities providing system improvements and operational support for monthly financial close cycles, so flexible work hours will be required to coordinate with global tasks and teams.

In this role, you will:

• Monitor system performance across multiple financial applications, maintain system documentation, provide administrative support, and provide user support for bug fixes and future enhancements.

• Work closely with the finance and engineering teams to understand functional requirements, system implementation and execute end-to-end integration testing

• Ensure accuracy and alignment with partner requirements and oversee user acceptance testing.

• Strive to become the system domain expert, find new opportunities for process improvements, dig deep into requests, and determine partner needs to solve problems.

• Ensure that incidents get resolved in an efficient and timely manner.

• Learn and use tools such as NetSuite, Salesforce, SoftCo, Expensify, Celigo, Nolan as well as custom built applications and integrations.

• Ensure strict alignment on compliance and control requirements, especially handling sensitive financial data and supporting IT SOX audits.

 

Please apply if you have:

• Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience, preferably with an engineering/technical background.

• 3+ years of finance systems experience.

• Technical skills with prior hands-on experience with financial systems such as ERP, AP Automation, AR Receivables, Travel and Expense, Enterprise O2C, R2R, P2P integration platforms.

• Previous experience with Netsuite is strongly preferred.

• Supported monthly financial close and have expertise in financial processes related to order to cash, procure to pay and record to report domains.

• Critical thinking and strong analytical skills, with great attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, adherence to data governance and control requirements.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to partner effectively with cross-functional teams.

• Eagerness to constantly learn and grow in the role while adapting to whatever new systems are needed in the future.

 

Benefits and Perks

• Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

• Focus on mental health and well-being:

• Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

• Company-paid subscription to Headspace

• Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

• Paid parental leave

• Generous paid vacation + time off for your birthday

• Paid volunteer time

• Focus on your career growth:

• Development Dollars

title: Graduate Data Engineer
description:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

THE ROLE

As a Data Engineering Graduate, you'll be an integral part of our Data Engineering team. From day one, you'll gain hands-on experience, taking on meaningful responsibility, and making a tangible impact. This role is ideal for someone who likes building things that last and wants to learn how reliable data infrastructure is designed, built and maintained at scale.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Pipeline development: you'll help build and maintain the data pipelines that ingest, clean and move data across our systems, learning how reliable data flows are engineered

- Data integration: you'll support the onboarding of new data sources, writing and testing the logic that brings partner data into our platform cleanly and consistently

- Transformation and modelling: you'll apply transformations that turn raw data into structured, trustworthy datasets the wider business can use

- Monitoring and reliability: you'll help keep our ingestion pipelines running, flagging issues early and learning how we maintain the integrity of our data operations

- Quality assurance: whether it's checking for anomalies or validating schemas and formats, your attention to detail will keep our data trustworthy and actionable

- Automation and process improvement: you'll help identify and implement ways to streamline and scale our data processes, bringing more automation, speed and accuracy to the team

- Documentation: you'll capture and update data rules, pipeline logic and key processes to support operational clarity and team knowledge sharing

- You'll use your natural curiosity to stay up to date with engineering practices and tools, contributing fresh ideas to the team

ABOUT YOU

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, mathematics, or a related field (or similar qualification)

- Some exposure to coding, ideally Python or SQL, through your studies, projects or self-teaching, with a genuine eagerness to deepen it

- A keen eye for detail and a passion for getting data right, because small errors can make a big difference downstream

- Comfortable picking up new tools, platforms and technical concepts quickly

- Proactive and inquisitive, happy to ask questions and figure things out

- Organised and methodical in how you approach tasks and documentation

- You thrive when working as part of a team

- Comfortable in a fast-paced environment

- Have excellent written and verbal English skills

- Last but not least, you'll have no ego!

What You’ll Get

- Private Health Care (Bupa)

- Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

- Travel Insurance

- Competitive Base Salary

- Company Bonus Scheme

- Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

- Market-Leading Training Programme

- Recognition & Reward Scheme

- Annual Company Conference

- Regular Happy Hours & Team Lunches

- Free Coffee, Drinks & Snacks

What’s the next step?

Our hiring process ensures we're recruiting the right people for the role. We ensure that people are as suitable for us as we are for them.

If you like the sound of what we're all about at Quantum and want to join a team where you can make an impact, please apply or contact us at careers@quantum.media.

title: Senior Director of Growth
description:
About Scale Media
For the past 12 years, Scale Media has been building and scaling science-backed wellness brands. Our portfolio of brands, including Live Conscious, 1MD, and Essential Elements, has grown to 9 figures in revenue while operating profitably with no external funding.
Our team is made up of operators, marketers, and builders focused on products consumers actually trust. We're investing heavily in data and AI to sharpen how we develop products and scale brands.
We believe the best decisions come from data, curiosity, and continuous learning. We value high ownership, candid feedback, and thoughtful execution. As a fully remote company, we lead with clear communication, accountability, and trust, and we give people real room to grow and make an impact.
Scale Media has been recognized as one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers, a Great Place to Work, an Inc. Best Workplace, and an Inc. 5000 company.
If you take ownership, think for yourself, and like solving hard problems alongside people who do the same, you'll fit right in.
The Role
We're looking for a Senior Director, Growth to lead our paid acquisition and Amazon teams across our portfolio of DTC wellness brands.
This is a senior role, but not a pure strategy role. We need someone with deep platform expertise who is in the data every day, managing performance with the team and raising the bar on media buying. We expect Meta and paid social to be our biggest growth levers, so strong Meta experience is essential, and you'll lead performance across every paid channel.
On top of daily performance, you'll work with the VP of Growth and Analytics to set LTV/CAC and MER targets by product line, decide what signal we send to every channel, and help shape how paid media supports retention. DTC paid media drives significant halo to Amazon, so you'll lead Amazon alongside DTC and manage how the two work together.
You'll partner closely with Analytics, Creative, and Ecommerce, and report to the VP of Growth.
What You'll Own

•
Daily performance management. Reviewing performance every day across brands, channels, and Amazon, catching issues and opportunities early, and driving the team to act on them.

•
Leading the paid acquisition and Amazon teams. Managing and developing both teams, raising the bar on media buying, and building the next layer of leaders.

•
Cross-channel strategy and budget allocation. Deciding where the next dollar goes across brands, product lines, and channels (Google, Meta, Bing, others).

•
Unit economics and targets. Working with the VP of Growth and Analytics to set LTV/CAC and MER targets by product line, and holding acquisition to them.

•
Signal strategy. Deciding what signal we send to each platform, such as value-based bidding, LTV- or margin-weighted conversions, and offline events, and making sure it's implemented correctly.

•
Amazon. Leading the Amazon channel and measuring and managing the halo between DTC paid media and Amazon sales.

•
Paid media and retention. Shaping how paid media supports retention, including existing-customer suppression, win-back, and new vs. returning customer reporting by channel.

•
Measurement. Working with Analytics and our measurement partners (MTA, lift testing, MMM) to continuously improve how we decide where to allocate budget.

•
Testing. Running a structured test roadmap across channels, tactics, offers, and landing pages, and knowing which results to scale and which to cut.

•
AI-enabled workflows. Driving the use of AI tools and automation across acquisition to speed up reporting, analysis, and optimization.

What Success Looks Like

• Double-digit new customer revenue growth while hitting brand and product-level LTV/CAC and MER targets

• Scaled paid media spend across channels and brands

• A daily performance rhythm where problems are caught and fixed in days, not weeks

• A media buying team that's measurably stronger and makes better decisions on its own

• Budget allocation driven by marginal return

title: HIM Cert Coder Pro Fee - Weekend Hours included
description:
Overview
The HIM Certified Coder is responsible for accurate and timely coding of hospital inpatient, hospital outpatient and/or professional fee encounters using appropriate ICD10/ICDPCS, CPT, or HCPCs codes and appropriate coding software such as computer assisted coding and encoders as a means to ensure compliant billing of Carle claims. HIM Certified Coder is responsible for understanding and applying all regulatory coding guidelines, such as National and Local Coverage Determinations and application of CPT modifiers. HIM Certified Coder is also responsible for understanding and applying coding knowledge to resolve billing edits related to coding. HIM coder uses Carle electronic medical record systems to review clinical encounters. Responsibilities

• Responsible for accurately coding all records according to the appropriate coding classification (ICD-10 and/or CPT and/or HCPCs and modifiers) system.

• The assignment of codes will accurately reflect the diagnoses and procedures pertinent to the patient.

• Provides interdepartmental coding assistance, as needed, to determine accurate coding assignment.

• Develops methodology to provide a coding process that is compliant with regulatory agencies including the utilization of reference materials such as, but not limited to,

• Center for Medicare Services (CMS) publications, Coding Clinic, CPT Assistant, etc.

• Facilitates optimization of revenue while maintaining compliance standards for the organization through varied venues and tasks (auditing/monitoring, training, facilitation of charges through the claim scrubber system, assisting with various patient or payor related charge/account inquiries, research on various coding/billing related topics as requested by various sources internal and external to the organization, etc.).

• Serves as an expert resource regarding CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, all other necessary coding systems, and regulatory guidelines for all internal and external parties.

• Serve as liaison for coding and billing staff to ensure accurate charge capture. Reports any documentation and coding improvement needs based upon review findings.

• Responsible for maintaining coding certification, knowledge and skills to successfully perform job duties

• Performs provider and peer coding audits as requested Assist with monitoring of internal controls for coding and billing. Facilitates external audit activities and reporting of such activities to the appropriate administrative personnel.

Qualifications
Certifications: Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC) - American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC); Certified Coding Specialist - Physician-Based (CCS-P) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA); Certified Coding Specialist (CCS) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA); Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA); Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) - American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA); Certified Professional Coder (CPC) - American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC); Certified Outpatient Coder (COC) - American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC), Education: , Work Experience:

title: Field Reimbursement Manager

ABOUT US

There are more than 9 million immunocompromised people in the United States. Almost half a million of those represent a population that are moderately to severely immunocompromised and at highest risk for severe COVID-19, including stem cell and solid organ transplant patients as well as those with hematologic cancers.

At Invivyd , Inc., we take those numbers very seriously and we come to work each day on a mission to deliver protection from serious viral infectious diseases, beginning with SARS-CoV-2. Invivyd deploys a proprietary integrated technology platform unique in the industry designed to assess, monitor, develop, and adapt to create best in class antibodies.

In March 2024 , Invivyd received emergency use authorization (EUA) from the U.S. FDA for a monoclonal antibody (mAb) in its pipeline of innovative antibody candidates.

In October 2025 , the FDA cleared the company's Investigational New Drug (IND) application and provided feedback to advance the company's REVOLUTION clinical program, Invivyd 's development program for VYD2311, a vaccine alternative monoclonal antibody being investigated for the prevention of COVID-19.

Be part of making a difference. Be part of Invivyd .

title: Senior ML Engineer - Speech (m/f/d)
description:
🎤 WHY VOIZE? BECAUSE WE’RE MORE THAN JUST A JOB!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don’t replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 YOUR MISSION

If you're a Machine Learning Engineer experienced with Speech recognition and are excited to work at the cutting edge of product design, applied ML research, and MLOps, then go ahead and apply! With us, you'll build products with direct user feedback, train AI models with real data, and ship new features to production every day.

🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS - NO TWO DAYS ARE ALIKE

- Take ownership for the design, training, evaluation, and deployment of our deep learning models in the space of speech recognition

title: Category Specialist (WM)
description:

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

At Wolt, we’re building technology that makes life in local neighborhoods simpler. Wolt Market is our online grocery business, bringing customers a curated range of everyday essentials quickly and reliably.

The Category Team shapes the assortment, promotions and supplier collaboration behind that experience. As a Category Specialist, you will be the operational backbone of the team ensuring promotional plans, data, communication and follow-ups move accurately and on time.

What you’ll be doing

This is a hands-on coordination role at the centre of the Category Team. You will work closely with Category Managers, suppliers and internal stakeholders to keep commercial activities organised, accurately documented and delivered on schedule.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

• Coordinate the collection, follow-up and communication of promotional plans with suppliers.

• Maintain accurate trackers, files and timelines for promotions, campaigns and category initiatives.

• Support Category Managers with administrative and executional tasks, including supplier and SKU-related processes.

• Act as a key point of contact between suppliers, Category Managers and internal teams, ensuring clear and timely activation of Promo Plan.

• Support post-campaign reporting and the preparation of materials used to evaluate promotions and commercial activities.

• Use systems, reporting tools and AI-enabled tools to improve accuracy, visibility and day-to-day efficiency.

• Experience in a coordination, commercial support, e-commerce or retail or FMCG role.

• Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

• Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills in Greek and English.

• Confidence working with Excel or Google Sheets, PowerPoint and everyday office tools.

• Comfort using systems and reporting tools, with curiosity and willingness to adopt AI and automation tools.

• A collaborative and hands-on approach, with the motivation to learn and grow in a commercial environment.

What’s in it for you

You’ll gain broad exposure to the commercial engine of a fast-growing online grocery business and work closely with Category Managers, suppliers and cross-functional teams. This role offers a strong foundation to build commercial, analytical and operational skills while helping shape more efficient ways of working through data, systems and AI.

Next steps

We review applications on a rolling basis. The recruitment process will include an initial conversation with Talent Acquisition, an interview with the hiring team and a practical assessment or working session relevant to the role. The Talent Acquisition team will guide you through the process and share the details at each stage.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table

title: Senior Facilities Operations Technician - Memphis

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. As a Sr. Facilities Operations Technician at SpaceXSI, you'll dive in, operating and maintaining the critical facility systems that power our supercomputing data centers. Working hands-on with MEP systems, you’ll tackle maintenance, operations, and repairs, ensuring peak performance and reliability. Expect to troubleshoot complex issues, streamline processes, and collaborate with teams to keep our infrastructure running smoothly, directly supporting xAI’s mission to accelerate human scientific discovery through AI.

• Develop and implement energy monitoring metrics.

• Strong troubleshooting skills.

• Experience with PLC-based control systems and/or with Building Management Systems (Client).

• Excellent written and verbal communication and technical writing skills in English.

Nutze TypeScript, Playwright sowie API- und Integrationstests, um das Verhalten im Storefront, in Shopware, im Payments-Service und an den Schnittstellen zu Zahlungsanbietern zu prüfen. Wähle die passende Testebene, statt jede Prüfung in einem Browser-Test abzubilden.

• Zahlungsergebnisse prüfen, nicht nur das UI-Verhalten. Kontrolliere Bestellerstellung, Zahlungsstatus, Beträge und Währungen. Ergänze die Testabdeckung entsprechend dem Produktrisiko um relevante Szenarien zu Stornierung, Einzug, Rückerstattung, Webhooks und Wiederherstellung.

• Integrationsfehler gemeinsam mit Entwickler:innen bewerten. Prüfe bei Bedarf Authentifizierung, Mandantentrennung, wiederholte Anfragen, Idempotenz und asynchrone Statusänderungen. Stelle sicher, dass Fehler weder doppelte Zahlungen noch inkonsistente Bestellungen verursachen.

• Testergebnisse für die Auslieferung nutzbar machen. Integriere und pflege Produkttests gemeinsam mit Engineering und Product Operations in der CI. Verbessere Testdaten, Wiederholbarkeit und Diagnosemöglichkeiten. Unterscheide zwischen Produktfehlern, Problemen bei Zahlungsanbietern oder Umgebungen und instabilen Tests.

• Releases und Kompatibilität validieren. Prüfe relevante Release-Artefakte, Upgrades und unterstützte Konfigurationen im bestehenden Release-Prozess. Überführe Erkenntnisse aus Vorfällen in Regressionstests und konkrete Verbesserungen.

• Eine klare QA-Empfehlung kommunizieren. Erläutere gegenüber Product und Engineering den geprüften Umfang, die Ergebnisse, verbleibende Risiken, Blocker und nächsten Schritte. Sprich Prioritätskonflikte frühzeitig an und begleite offene Punkte bis zu ihrer Lösung, einer vereinbarten Übergabe oder einer klaren Entscheidung.

• Verantwortung und Wissen teilen. Prüfe Testcode, arbeite mit Kolleg:innen im Pairing und verbessere gemeinsam nutzbare Fixtures und Dokumentation. Stimme dich mit anderen Quality Engineers ab, damit die Testabdeckung von mehreren Personen gepflegt und unterstützt werden kann.

Das bringst du mit:

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Pflege automatisierter Tests für produktive Software, einschließlich API- und Integrationstests sowie End-to-End-Tests.

• Sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in TypeScript oder JavaS

description:

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

 

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

 

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми в пошуку System Administrator.

Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі:
- підтримка IT інфраструктури;
- керування постачальниками послуг;
- контроль доступу до систем та сервісів;
- допомога не технічним командам у вирішенні технічних задач.

Що для нас важливо:
- Розуміння принципів керування доступами: SSO, MFA, групи та ролі, принцип мінімальних прав
- Практичний досвід з Google Workspace або схожим сервісом (користувачі, групи, пошта)
- Базові знання DNS, мереж і VPN
- Впевнена робота з Windows/macOS
- Уміння швидко розбиратися в нових SaaS-сервісах та читати англомовну документацію
- Акуратність, уважність до деталей, відповідальність за доступи й облікові дані
- Комунікабельність: чітке спілкування зі співробітниками, уточнення запитів, пояснення рішень простою мовою
- Виражене бажання рости й вчитися в адмініструванні, безпеці та автоматизації

Буде перевагою:
- Досвід з Okta або іншим IdP (Azure AD, JumpCloud)
- Досвід з менеджерами паролів (1Password, Bitwarden)
- Cloudflare: DNS, керування доменами; розуміння SPF/DKIM/DMARC
- GCP (IAM, service accounts)
- IaC (Terraform, Pulumi) та Git
- MDM для Apple (Jamf, Kandji, Intune)
- Скриптинг (Python, Bash) або автоматизація через n8n, Zapier
- Досвід у техпідтримці чи helpdesk, робота з тікет-системами (YouTrack, Jira)
- Slack на рівні адміністратора
- Інтерес до безпеки та compliance (PCI DSS, ISO 27001), AI-інструментів (ChatGPT, Claude)

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

- Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір - від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави.

- Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат - з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше.

- Турбота про щоденний комфорт. Сніданки, обіди, доступ до спортивних тренувань в Києві або часткова компенсація занять у Варшаві, медичне страхування, оплачувані відрядження, якщо специфіка ролі передбачає такі поїздки, корпоративні знижки від партнерів.

The Closing Specialist is responsible for coordinating real estate closings and managing the full lifecycle of closing transactions. • Capacity to work under pressure and tight deadlines.

We at Acxelsus are on a mission to showcase exceptional Filipino talent globally. Beyond educational credentials and professional experience, we highly prioritize passion, dedication, loyalty, and a proactive attitude towards personal growth.
Our foundation is built upon a set of core values - R.I.G.H.T. - representing Reliability, Integrity, Goal-Oriented mindset, Happiness, and Teamwork. These values define our identity and guide our approach to achieving success.
If you are passionate about advancing your career, forging genuine connections, and becoming part of a team committed to your success, join us!
Job Overview
We are looking for an Accounts Receivable & Collections Specialist to support an Australian client with growing transaction volumes. In this role, you will manage overdue customer accounts through direct phone and email contact, secure payment commitments, and help reduce outstanding debt. You will work closely with the client's finance team on shared customer accounts and own the month-end credit insurance reporting on overdue accounts.
Key Responsibilities

•
Overdue Account Follow-Up: Confidently contact customers with overdue accounts by phone and email to understand reasons for non-payment and secure payment commitments that reduce outstanding debt.

•
Team Collaboration: Work closely with the client's finance team, who handle routine collections before the due date, to ensure a smooth handover of accounts once they become overdue and consistent communication with customers.

•
Internal Dispute Resolution: Coordinate with internal managers so that invoice disputes and contract requirements are addressed in a timely manner.

•
Clear Account Communication: Clearly and accurately explain payment terms, outstanding balances, and dispute resolutions across phone and email.

•
Ledger Reconciliation: Reconcile customer ledgers, including offsetting credit notes against invoices and allocating unapplied payments.

•
Credit Limit Monitoring: Monitor customer balances to ensure agreed credit limits are not breached; run risk assessments, review credit files, and flag high-risk accounts.

•
Doubtful Debt Provision: Calculate doubtful debt provision requirements based on company policy.

•
Month-End Credit Insurance Reporting : Prepare month-end reports on overdue accounts as required by the credit insurance provider.

•
Continuous Improvement: Follow the established collections process, prioritize where required, and suggest better ways of working.

Qualifications

•
Experience: At least 2 years of proven experience in accounts receivable, credit control, or B2B collections, ideally supporting Australian or other offshore clients.

•
Functional Skill: Strong collections and negotiation skills, with the ability to handle difficult conversations and customer pushback while keeping relationships professional; commercially aware of the cash flow and bad-debt impact of overdue accounts.

•
Tech Skills: Intermediate Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, filters, formatting, and basic formulas). Experience with Creditor Watch or Microsoft Dynamics Business Central is an advantage but not required; training will be provided.

•
Soft Skills: Assertive yet diplomatic, an active listener who can identify the root cause of payment delays and negotiate realistic payment solutions on the spot. Proactive, organized, and collaborative.

•
Language: Excellent spoken English with clear pronunciation, professional phrasing, and the ability to build rapport easily over the phone; strong written English for email correspondence.

•
Education: Bachelor's degree in Accountancy, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

What We Offer
Here at Acxelsus , our people come first. We offer total compensation to ensure our team experiences overall wellness and has the financial resources and support they need.

• Market-competitive salary

• Health & group life Insurance

• Fixed weekends off; Dayshift schedule

• Paid time off

title: Support Engineer (APAC - Weekends)
description:
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

We are seeking Support Engineers to provide world-class developer support for anyone experiencing issues or seeking guidance when using Supabase. The support team is globally distributed with a strong focus on minimizing time to fix, and works closely with the product engineering and growth teams.

You will:

- Provide initial and timely responses to all support cases for a variety of topics, from billing or pre-sales requests to optimization or implementation questions.

- Triage support cases including directing users to previous answers, code examples, documentation, or escalating to specific technical or business team members.

- Monitor multiple feedback channels, e.g. Github Issues & Discussions (check them here: https://github.com/supabase/supabase/issues).

- Identify where internal tooling might be developed or obtained to improve support efficiency.

- Reproduce issues, create test cases and improve test coverage, if you have experience with testing.

You are:

- Experienced in customer support, with 3+ years of experience providing developer support to technical customers.

- Proficient in SQL (ideally PostgreSQL). You feel comfortable with complex SQL queries. If you have a database administration experience, it’s a plus.

- Excellent communication skills and fluency in English.

- Skilled in using Linux/Unix operating systems and the command line.

- Experienced working with GitHub Issues and Discussions.

- Bonus points if you're familiar with popular JavaScript frameworks like React, Vue, and Svelte and have some experience with Node.js.

- Having a degree in Computer Science is a plus too.

TIMEZONES & LOGISTICS

- It’s a full-time position permanently, with four 10-hour shifts covering weekends during APAC Hours: 00:00-10:00 UTC

- We are primarily looking for someone in Southeast Asia or India time zones for this shift.

- This position covers Friday → Monday based on the above UTC times, so this may vary slightly for your specific timezone.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment-laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning-courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support-not replace-existing tools and communities.

Service Measure (SM) is a field data collection company founded in 2013 in New York.

title: Senior Paid Marketing Manager
description:
Hi 👋 I'm Harriet, and I lead Marketing at Ashby.

We've built a business with 5,500+ customers, a highly differentiated product, and a brand that people genuinely care about. We've invested in content, customer stories, community, and the foundations of a strong marketing program. Now, we have an opportunity to build a much bigger paid engine to support our next stage of growth.

We're looking for a Senior Paid Marketing Manager to build it.

You'll take ownership of our existing LinkedIn program and expand across Meta, Google Search, YouTube, and other channels. You'll have meaningful budget, strong creative and technical partners, and the autonomy to build a program that creates qualified pipeline and strengthens our brand.

This is a hands-on role. We want someone who knows their channels inside out, enjoys getting into the details, and can take a campaign from initial hypothesis through execution, analysis, and optimization. You'll have access to specialist support when it makes sense, but you'll be the person driving the work.

We also believe AI creates an opportunity for exceptional individual contributors to do work that previously required much larger teams. We're looking for someone who is already exploring that opportunity and wants to push it further.

WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE INTERESTING

You get to build with the resources most marketers wish they had.

Paid is relatively underdeveloped at Ashby compared with the scale of our business. You get to build something substantial without unwinding years of accumulated complexity or fighting for the resources to make it work. We have strong content, customer proof, product differentiation, and an established brand. You'll start with a monthly budget in the hundreds of thousands of dollars and the support of our design, web, and RevOps teams.

YOU CAN RETHINK HOW PAID MARKETING GETS DONE.

We want to enable exceptional individual contributors to accomplish more through AI, automation, and better workflows. You'll have the freedom to experiment with new tools, build systems that improve your output, and challenge established ways of working.

YOU'LL BUILD A PROGRAM THAT MAKES THE BRAND AND BUSINESS STRONGER.

We believe great paid marketing combines analytical rigor with creative judgment. You'll optimize for pipeline and efficiency while building campaigns that earn attention, communicate our differentiation, and give the right buyers a reason to care about Ashby. We don't want a lead-generation machine that makes our brand worse.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Build and scale our paid program. Own strategy and execution across LinkedIn, Meta, and Google Search, expanding into YouTube and other channels as opportunities emerge. Prioritize audiences, develop campaign hypotheses, manage budgets, and turn promising experiments into repeatable sources of qualified pipeline.

Drive creative strategy and experimentation. Develop campaign concepts, write ad copy, brief creative, and shape landing-page tests. Work closely with design, content, and product marketing to produce distinctive work. Build a disciplined testing cadence across audiences, creative, offers, and conversion paths, knowing when to scale, iterate, or stop.

Use AI to increase your impact. Build practical workflows using AI, agents, and automation to improve research, creative iteration, campaign operations, and analysis. We want someone who actively experiments with new approaches, evaluates their effectiveness, and turns what works into repeatable systems.

Own measurement and performance. Drive our approach to paid measurement in partnership with RevOps. Establish the signals and reporting needed to understand qualified reach, conversion, pipeline contribution, and efficiency. Develop better ways to assess incrementality, make informed decisions with imperfect attribution, and translate performance data into clear investment recommendations.

title: AR / AP Accounting Analyst
description:
At Kognitiv Inc. , we’re redefining what it means to be a Workday partner. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the ecosystem, we bring deep expertise, innovative thinking, and a people-first mindset to everything we do. We’re not just building better Workday solutions-we’re building a company where talented people thrive.
Ready to do your best work? Join us.
Working hours: 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time. This is a night shift locally, with full overlap with U.S. clients and the finance team, including during training.

What You'll Do
Own Global AR and Collections

• Generate accurate customer invoices on schedule, checking terms against contracts, purchase orders, and non-standard agreements.

• Maintain invoicing schedules and global customer master records in financial systems, and use customer invoicing portals to submit invoices and follow up.

• Proactively contact business clients about past-due balances by phone and email across international time zones. Discuss payment arrangements, respond to incoming calls, and maintain professional client relationships.

• Research and resolve billing discrepancies, disputes, and customer questions with project managers, commercial teams, and finance colleagues.

• Void invoices, issue credits, and record customer payments, checking amounts, currencies, and transaction dates for accuracy.

• Prepare, reconcile, and analyze monthly AR aging files, and support monthly and quarterly close procedures with attention to how transactions affect the books.

Provide Backup AP Support

• Cross-train across the full AP lifecycle so you can provide coverage while keeping AR as your primary responsibility.

• Help review, code, and process vendor invoices, expense reports, and travel claims.

• Support weekly payment runs, fund transfers, and vendor bank detail verification.

• Monitor global AP mailboxes, help resolve vendor inquiries, and maintain AP standard operating procedures.

Support Accounting and Audit

• Prepare balance sheet and ledger reconciliations for AR and AP accounts.

• Provide transaction documentation for internal and external audits.

• Maintain accurate financial data and help with ad hoc accounting projects.

What You'll Bring

• Relevant accounting or finance experience with hands-on responsibility for full-cycle AR, credit control, and business-to-business collections.

• Working knowledge of general ledger accounting, invoice reconciliation, and month-end close, including how invoices, credits, voids, and payments affect accounting records.

• Experience using a large enterprise resource planning (ERP) system, such as Workday, Oracle, or SAP.

• Experience working with multiple currencies and the attention to detail to record invoices and payments correctly.

• Strong spoken and written English, with the confidence to initiate calls, discuss and negotiate payments, and resolve questions with customers across regions and time zones.

• A collaborative approach: you follow up proactively, ask questions, and work through issues with project managers and the finance team.

• Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including lookups and pivot tables.

• A practical approach to solving billing and payment issues, discretion with confidential financial data, and the ability to balance AR priorities with backup AP coverage.

• Availability to work the stated U.S. Eastern Time schedule.

Helpful Experience but Not Required

• Familiarity with accounts payable workflows.

• Working in a professional services environment.

• Using Projector or Workday PSA.

• Working with customer invoicing portals, particularly Coupa or Ariba.

• Using AI tools in your work or personal projects, with examples of how they've been useful.

title: Menlo Fellows
description:
The Role
Menlo builds open source and production AI systems, from the brain, to developer facing tools to the runtime infrastructure and humanoid platform underneath. This fellowship is deliberately open ended: tell us your strengths and we'll match you to high impact work across software engineering, systems, applied AI, or research. You'll be hands on from day one, with a Menlo engineer or researcher directly responsible for your mentorship and your results. You own deliverables at the same level as the team you join. We expect you to contribute, not observe.
This is a paid internship program that runs year round. Candidates go through a rigorous interview process and get matched with a senior researcher or engineer working on real world problems.
What You'll Do

• Own a real project end to end, from problem definition through implementation, testing, and documentation.

• Ship production grade work in one or more areas: product engineering, systems, infrastructure, applied AI, or research.

• Work on core Menlo projects, including developer tooling, model runtime and performance, automation, and reliability improvements.

• Debug real issues across codebases and environments, and propose fixes that improve correctness, performance, and maintainability.

• Write clear docs, runbooks, or internal notes that make your work easy for the team to adopt.

• Collaborate closely with engineers and researchers through code reviews and technical discussions.

What We Look For

• University, high school or mid-career individuals looking for a crash course in physical AI and robotics

• The ability to read unfamiliar codebases and make safe, well scoped changes.

• Practical debugging skills: you can isolate problems and validate fixes.

• A grasp of software or hardware engineering basics: testing, version control, and review.

• A high ownership mindset and the ability to work independently with fast feedback loops.

• Above all, we hire for slope: how fast you grow matters more than where you start.

Logistics

• 3 months minimum, based in one of our offices: San Francisco, Ho Chi Minh City, or Singapore

• Paid role.

• Open to pre university and university students.

• You'll need existing work authorization for your office location, as we don't provide visa sponsorship for this role.

Why Join Menlo
You'll do real work that ships, not busywork on the bench. Genuine ownership, direct mentorship from the people building Asimov, and a chance to prove yourself on hard problems alongside some of the most curious and driven people you'll meet. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.
A Note on AI
You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.
Equal Opportunity and Accommodations
